menuLabel: Generate a test, report or export
bugReportCopyFailed: Could not copy the bug report
describePlaywright: The recorded navigation and user actions as a Playwright test. With HAR replay, the network answers from {fileName} next to the test (download it from Generate → HAR file).
describePlaywrightMocks: The same test, with up to {count} recorded responses served by context.route mocks.
describeBugReport: Markdown with the session, errors, failed and slow requests and what the recording did not capture.
describeHar: The requests of the range as an HTTP Archive (HAR 1.2), for DevTools or Playwright's routeFromHAR.
describeGitHubIssue: An issue title, labels and a body with the session evidence.
describeJiraIssue: A Jira issue payload (summary, type, labels, description) with the session evidence.
rangeInvalid: Enter the time in seconds from the session start, e.g. 9.45
rangeTooShort: The range must be at least {min} ms long
videoNote: Tab video as recorded, without the player's overlay
videoNoneLite: Lite recordings do not record the tab video
videoNone: This recording has no tab video
videoNoneFailed: The tab video failed to record: {error}
videoMissingChunks: Missing from the archive: chunks {chunks} of {total}
videoAsRecorded: Saved as recorded: some players may not show its length
